Df.bar_b_note: B's mossy olive newt has the right naturalistic family, but it is a low, mid-value mound that barely clears the trainer and dissolves into a log shape in the faint poses; A's lime-and-black camo reads as a placeholder texture, not a Palworld-class creature.

Uh.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder villager (expressive eyes, white hair, olive vest and green scarf) whose palette sits in the key art's earthy world; only the slightly toy-like face separates it from the naturalistic creature style.

Sh.bar_b_note: B's panel is legible and on-direction (blue-grey translucent, warm gold ingredient lines, iconised Craft/Leave), but the oversized recipe cells show only about three recipes and the murky, near-black world behind it is nowhere near Palworld's bright finish.

Sn.bar_b_note: A dark brown-green murk with no purple storm sky, lightning or light shafts, flat magenta ground rings as telegraphs, a tiny barely visible player creature and a HUD that covers much of each frame sank it, although the golden Voltarach spider itself is on-board.

Hv.bar_b_note: B's white-and-ice-blue wolf has a clear silhouette, black ear tips and proper scale over the trainer, but its fur is flat white with little value structure and the faint mid frame floats above its shadow; A's faint end collapses into an upright white blob.

top_changes.change: Relight Stormwood fights: purple storm sky and white-violet lightning, rim light on both fighters, a camera that keeps trunks and canopy out of frame, and replace the flat magenta telegraph rings with real lightning/stone ground effects; slim down the fight HUD.
Creature material pass for value range and rim light (Df newt moss and belly, Hv fur shading, Voltarach blue glow), plus fix the faint-end poses so the face stays visible and the body stays grounded.
Rebuild the Df moss newt to the Mosshock board: taller-than-trainer body, a big amber-eyed readable head and a clear silhouette instead of a low lumpy mound.
